rule: A single episode may be used for an operations curriculum; a selected control package requires all of its conditions and paired records, without cherry-picking successful cases

control_packages.comparison_and_qualification: Ge/silica cladding cracks and released fragments versus the released Ge/ASG core; process parameters are missing, so do not claim strict quantitative single-variable attribution
Ge/BSG spheroidization/perturbations versus Ge/ASG; do not fabricate uniform matched settings
Silica neck profiles with/without a core, retaining quench-crack history
Original Ge/two claddings/released; not pristine stress ground truth
Each retains its original-rod reference, dedicated cross-sections, and lamella child lineage
Si532nm and Ge1550nm; do not arbitrarily change to a common wavelength and call it a source condition
Same-object front/side, changing only the relative direction of incidence
Three metrics for the two single-core devices, with independent destructive sibling samples
before/after within each episode; symmetric Si/Ge expansion is a task choice and does not imply 8 independent source experiments
Comparison of fibre/commercial proxies under the same phantom preset input, not reproduction of a human experiment

statistical_pack.authored_allocation: Default to independent sibling samples for different metric groups; explicitly cross-reference shared nondestructive groups without assuming the authors' allocation
statistical_pack.requirement: Distinct sample IDs cannot be fabricated from repeated acquisition on the same object; an incomplete statistical package does not establish coverage of the n values

count_warning: Control packages, cycles, and task configurations cannot be added together as the authors' total experiment count
